newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa raised to buy.

text.p: - Finamex brokerage analyst Francisco Rivero said he upgraded Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa to buy from hold after revising the company's 1997 earnings estimates.

- "In our new estimates we anticipate, on a proforma basis, several transactions through which the company will substantially improve its cash position and reduce its 1997 enterprise value (EV) by 5.6 billion pesos, making it more attractive," Rivero said in a report.
- Rivero said Finamex's 1997 sales estimate of 14.5 billion pesos represents a real increase of 8.4 percent from the 1996 estimated sales forecast.
- "This high single-digit growth translates into strong increases of 54.2 percent in operating income," Rivero said.
- "Since around 70 percent of all costs and operating expenses are fixed, operating margin is extremely sensitive to changes in any direction at the top line," he added.

- "Given Televisa's improving fundamentals in 1997, our belief that liquid blue chips will attract renewed investor interest early in the new year, and the fact that Televisa is currently at what we believe to be the tail of a breif period of underperformance, we find the current timing excellent for investors to take a position in Televisa," Rivero concluded.
